title: research: certify the actual stage-zero Gaussian commutation premise
body:
PR #4457 leaves open whether the actual complex caller satisfies the stage-zero premise `[D0,Q]=0`. This adds one scoped proof and independent exact checker in `research/stage-zero-commutation-audit/`, starting from current canonical main `2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db`.

For the source-specified Gaussian `C_a=((1+i)I+(1-i)T_a)/2`, XOR translations commute, so the actual port operators satisfy `D0 Q = Q D0 = F9`. The identity lifts algebraically to every positive column multiplicity. The checker binds all 112 port normals, the native entrance/exit spaces, 448 initial caller maps and #4440's retained p17 initial call, without importing a predecessor evaluator.

There is a useful qualification to the suggested tensor factorization: **every recorded rank-eight normalization needs its nonzero translation**. The exact identity is `D0=T_t product C_b`. At port 0, dropping `t=15` gives coefficient error `-1/16` on input/output address 0. Keeping the translation preserves commutation; no existing supplier bug or new cost saving is asserted.

**Evidence**
- 114,688 exact Gaussian-dyadic commutator coefficients across both conjugate orientations; 57,344 independent Fourier-character comparisons.
- 338 semantic/binding rejection cases: missing translation, wrong inverse, a genuinely noncommuting phase, wrong port and altered initial map.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and metadata/source pins pass, standard library only.
- Git-free `-I -O -B` export reproduces the exact receipt and rejects changed source bytes and a changed receipt.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for all 15 package/input files at `82c7db427100033aa1275ecdb16ebc2e2ef10b91`.

Reproduce:
```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/stage-zero-commutation-audit
python -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/stage-zero-commutation-audit --check-source-history
```

**Scope and remaining limits:** this proves the named implication for the source-specified physical reference operators. Full native/adapter realization for arbitrary columns, rounded implementation, BIT, cost accounting and the outer theorem remain separate obligations. No full selected cold replay, independent human review, formal proof-kernel verification or new kappa is claimed. The selected baseline orientation command stopped on an omitted claim file in the sparse checkout; that limitation is recorded in TASK.json. Hosted CI is pending.

**Coordination and credit:** [canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4461). The submission refresh covered 317 open PRs, 3,318 Discussion records and every tracked top-level README/TASK note. #4457 already covered the transport audit initially considered, so this follows its explicit open question 1; #4455 and #4448 remain complementary. Credit to Mark/Matarener, zxv, Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained QQ16/native phase lineage, including ywz65. Prepared for Mihir Srivastava / mihir-s-05 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. No merge or selected-frontier change.
